decision.metric: team points per battle, not battle-win percentage
decision.primaryUnit: Eight independent randomized partition means; each averages its 25 cohorts and two distinct seed blocks.
decision.gate: After every arm/partition and the four original-engine replays complete: candidate pooled delta > 0 AND partition-mean 95% interval lower bound > 0 against EACH exact control, plus exact original replay scores.
decision.caveat: Nominal per-contrast 95% intervals, not simultaneous familywise confidence. Panel randomization inference on this fixed public pool, not universal superiority.
decision.otherwise: If any control contrast has 95% upper bound < 0, report supported inferiority to at least one control on this pool; otherwise inconclusive. Negative observed mean alone is not supported inferiority. No universal inference, adaptive stopping, old-result pooling, automatic final replacement, or unrequested leader modifications.

result.limits: Exact byte reproduction and isolated original-engine recurrence only, not broad superiority or immunity. Final competitive verification follows a separate frozen protocol.

randomness.algorithm: Independent 32-byte salts; SHA256(salt||uint64be counter), rejection-sampled unbiased Fisher-Yates over sorted full75 roster.
